text: The wheat is mixed with fermented milk and left to sour, then dried. The cultures are those listed in Table 2 of the review, which spells the names the old way; its "Lb. lactis" most likely means Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. lactis, so that one is left out here.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.
